strategy_notes: Focus on high‑conviction short setups in sectors showing weakness (tech semis, defense contracts, consumer discretionary) while avoiding low‑conviction entries and any long positions that break below VWAP in a risk‑off market. Keep at least 75% of each team’s allocated capital deployed during open hours and use tighter conviction and position limits to protect the portfolio. Leverage the tech team’s edge on semiconductor shorts and the defense team’s contract‑driven opportunities, but scale back space, entertainment and healthcare exposure until win rates improve.

defense: long BAH only if post‑earnings contract award confirmed
space: long BA only on confirmed contract award
entertainment: short NFLX only if price below VWAP and momentum negative
tech: do not go long any ticker below VWAP
short AAPL only with clear technical breakdown
consumer: short AMZN if price < VWAP and momentum negative
financials: avoid long positions in volatile names
healthcare: short MRNA on earnings miss signal
avoid defensive longs that sit below VWAP
